layout.buttonFallback: If the button does not work, open this address:

auth.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

verification.subject: Verify email address
verification.preheader: One click, and your address is verified.
verification.heading: Verify email address
verification.body: please verify your email address for eXocortex.

passwordReset.subject: Reset password
passwordReset.preheader: Set a new password using the link in this email.
passwordReset.heading: Reset password
passwordReset.body: you can set a new password for eXocortex using the link below.

invitation.subject: Invitation
invitation.invitedWorkspace: {inviter} has invited you to the workspace “{workspace}” in eXocortex.
invitation.heading: You’re invited
invitation.validity: The link is valid until {date} and can only be used once.
invitation.footer: If you have nothing to do with this, no action is needed: no account will be created without this link.

scope.SUBTREE: The page and everything under it

granted.subject: {actor} shared “{title}” with you
granted.heading: “{title}” was shared with you
granted.body: {actor} shared the page “{title}” in eXocortex with you.
granted.noMembership: You do not need to be a member of any workspace for this. The page is now available in your “Shared with me” list.

changed.subject: Your share for “{title}” has changed
changed.heading: Your share has changed
changed.body: {actor} changed your permissions on the page “{title}”. Effective immediately:

revoked.subject: Your access to “{title}” has ended
revoked.heading: Your access has ended
revoked.body: {actor} revoked your share for the page “{title}” in eXocortex. As a result, the page can no longer be opened.
revoked.stillShared: What is still shared with you

commentDigest.subject: {count, plural, one {# new comment} other {# new comments}} on {pages, plural, one {one page} other {# pages}}
commentDigest.preheader: {count, plural, one {# new comment} other {# new comments}} on {pages, plural, one {one page} other {# pages}}.
commentDigest.heading: {count, plural, one {One new comment} other {# new comments}}
commentDigest.intro: {count, plural, one {a new comment was added to a page you follow:} other {# new comments were added to pages you follow:}}
commentDigest.moreComments: {count, plural, one {and one more} other {and # more}}
commentDigest.morePages: {count, plural, one {Something also happened on one more page.} other {Something also happened on # more pages.}}
commentDigest.footer: You are receiving this email because you turned on comment emails under Settings → Notifications. You can also turn them off again there or switch to once daily.

automationPage.body: Automation “{rule}” is sending you the page “{title}”.
automationPage.truncated: The page is cut off here. It is best to read the rest in eXocortex.

reason.WEBHOOK_FAILED: The server the rule reports to rejected it or was unreachable.
reason.AI_FAILED: The rule’s AI task failed, for example because the model did not respond or AI is turned off.
reason.PAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The page the rule operates on could not be read or written to with your account.
reason.OWNER_UNAVAILABLE: Your account cannot run the rule right now, for example without a verified email address.
reason.MAIL_FAILED: The rule could not send the page as an email.

disabled.subject: Automation “{rule}” has turned itself off
disabled.preheader: {count, plural, one {After one failure, it is no longer doing anything.} other {After # consecutive failures, it is no longer doing anything.}}
disabled.heading: An automation has turned itself off
disabled.body: {count, plural, one {your automation “{rule}” failed and has therefore turned itself off.} other {your automation “{rule}” failed # times in a row and has therefore turned itself off.}}
disabled.notice: It will not do anything more until you turn it back on.
disabled.whereToLook: The rule’s history shows what happened during each run. You can also turn it back on there.

runFailed.subject: Scheduled run of “{rule}” failed
runFailed.heading: A scheduled run failed
runFailed.body: the scheduled run of your automation “{rule}” failed.
runFailed.stays: The rule remains enabled and will try again at the next scheduled time.
runFailed.remaining: {count, plural, one {If the next run also fails, the rule will turn itself off.} other {After # more consecutive failures, the rule will turn itself off.}}
runFailed.footer: We won’t notify you individually about further failures in the same series.
